Coal primary energy used in combination with CCS
FRIDA Variable: Fossil energy coal.Primary Fossil Energy FUEL + Fossil energy coal.endogenous share of emissions stored
Transformation: multiply by 1000 (ZJ -> EJ) then by the endogenous share of emissions routed to storage rather than the carbon tax (FRIDA's per-fuel CCS adoption decision, joined per scenario/run/year); this allocation share stands in for the energy w/ CCS split, which FRIDA does not model at plant level

IAMC Description: Gas primary energy used in combination with CCS
FRIDA Variable: Fossil energy gas.Primary Fossil Energy FUEL + Fossil energy gas.endogenous share of emissions stored
Transformation: multiply by 1000 (ZJ -> EJ) then by the endogenous share of emissions routed to storage rather than the carbon tax (FRIDA's per-fuel CCS adoption decision, joined per scenario/run/year); this allocation share stands in for the energy w/ CCS split, which FRIDA does not model at plant level

IAMC Description: Oil primary energy used in combination with CCS
FRIDA Variable: Fossil energy oil.Primary Fossil Energy FUEL + Fossil energy oil.endogenous share of emissions stored
Transformation: multiply by 1000 (ZJ -> EJ) then by the endogenous share of emissions routed to storage rather than the carbon tax (FRIDA's per-fuel CCS adoption decision, joined per scenario/run/year); this allocation share stands in for the energy w/ CCS split, which FRIDA does not model at plant level

IAMC Description: Fossil primary energy used in combination with CCS
Transformation: sum of the three per-fuel w/ CCS series

IAMC Description: Biomass primary energy used in combination with CCS
FRIDA Variable: Bio fuel energy.bio fuel primary energy + Fossil energy oil.endogenous share of emissions stored
Transformation: multiply by 1000 (ZJ -> EJ) then by the oil endogenous storage-allocation share, joined per scenario/run/year (team decision: biofuel liquids burn in oil-type plants, FRIDA caps biofuel burning-emissions storage at the oil parameters, so the oil share stands in for the biomass energy w/ CCS split - same basis as the fossil w/ CCS variables); biofuel has a real primary energy series in FRIDA (energy content x production) so it is used directly, like coal/oil/gas; replaces the capture-based split (capturable 0.56 x realized BECC capture rate)

IAMC Description: Biomass primary energy without CCS
FRIDA Variable: Bio fuel energy.bio fuel primary energy + Fossil energy oil.endogenous share of emissions stored
Transformation: multiply by 1000 (ZJ -> EJ) then by (1 - share): complement of the oil endogenous storage-allocation share, joined per scenario/run/year (team decision - see the w/ CCS row); biofuel has a real primary energy series in FRIDA (energy content x production) so it is used directly, like coal/oil/gas; replaces the capture-based split (capturable 0.56 x realized BECC capture rate)

IAMC Description: Biofuel secondary energy output; the bio share of liquid fuels in the oil sector
FRIDA Variable: Bio fuel energy.bio fuel secondary energy output
Transformation: multiply by 0.0036 (TWh -> EJ); no efficiency division - secondary energy stays at output. FRIDA computes this as Fossil energy oil.secondary energy output from liquid fuels x Fossil energy oil.share of liquid fuel that is bio, with the oil sector taking the complementary (1 - share)
